subject: Chemistry
title: Oxidative Cleavage of Alkenes: Ozonolysis & Hydroxylation Dynamics
topics: Syn-Dihydroxylation using Cold 1% Alkaline KMnO₄ (Baeyer's Reagent) and OsO₄
Anti-Dihydroxylation using Peroxyacids (RCO₃H) followed by H₃O⁺
Reductive Ozonolysis (O₃ followed by Zn/H₂O or Me₂S; yields Aldehydes & Ketones)
Oxidative Ozonolysis (O₃ followed by H₂O₂; converts Aldehydes to Carboxylic Acids)
Stereospecific Halogenation: Anti-addition across Cis vs Trans alkenes (Meso vs Racemic)
quickSummary: Baeyer's reagent gives syn-1,2-diols (purple disappears, brown MnO₂ forms). Reductive ozonolysis (Zn/H₂O) cleaves C=C into aldehydes/ketones; Oxidative (H₂O₂) oxidizes aldehydes to acids. Anti-addition of Br₂ on trans-alkene yields meso compound.
summary: Master oxidative cleavage of alkenes via ozonolysis, dihydroxylation pathways, and stereospecific halogen additions.

conceptBreakdown.title: 5.1 Ozonolysis: Reductive vs Oxidative Cleavage

summaryBox.title: Ozonolysis Types
summaryBox.takeaway: Reductive (Zn/H₂O) → Aldehydes & Ketones. Oxidative (H₂O₂) → Carboxylic Acids & Ketones.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
REDUCTIVE OZONOLYSIS MECHANISM

R₂C=CH-R' ──[1. O₃]──► Molozonide → Ozonide ──[2. Zn/H₂O]──► R₂C=O (Ketone) + R'CHO (Aldehyde) + ZnO

Oxidative Ozonolysis (H₂O₂):
R'CHO is further oxidized by H₂O₂ to R'COOH (Carboxylic Acid).
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Reductive Ozonolysis**: $\text{Zn}$ dust destroys $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ produced during hydrolysis, preserving aldehydes from over-oxidation ($R\text{CH=CH}R' \to R\text{CHO} + R'\text{CHO}$).
• **Oxidative Ozonolysis**: Performed with $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, converting all aldehyde fragments quantitatively to carboxylic acids ($R\text{CHO} \to R\text{COOH}$).

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
STEREOSPECIFIC ADDITION RULES

• Baeyer's Reagent (Cold alk. KMnO₄) / OsO₄ ──► Syn-Dihydroxylation (cis-1,2-diols)
• Peroxyacid (RCO₃H) + H₃O⁺ ──► Anti-Dihydroxylation (trans-1,2-diols)
• Br₂ / CCl₄ Anti-Addition:
  ├── trans-2-butene + Anti Br₂ ──► meso-2,3-dibromobutane (Optically Inactive!)
  └── cis-2-butene + Anti Br₂   ──► (±) racemic-2,3-dibromobutane (dl-pair)
conceptBreakdown.content: Addition of $\text{Br}_2$ to alkenes proceeds through a cyclic bromonium ion intermediate, resulting in strict **Anti-Addition**. Anti-addition to a *trans*-alkene yields the symmetrical *meso* compound; anti-addition to a *cis*-alkene yields a racemic pair.

quickRevision: Oxidative ozonolysis (H₂O₂) oxidizes aldehydes to carboxylic acids.
trans-alkene + anti Br₂ addition = meso compound.
